NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS________________________________________
Notice is hereby given that the American Fork City Planning Commission will hold a Public Hearing on September 2, 2026, in the City Hall, located at 31 N. Church Street, commencing at 6:30 PM. 
The public and each affected entity is invited to provide information and comment for American Fork City to consider in the process of the proposed items.

-	Notice of public hearings and public meetings on adoption or modification of land use regulation.

o	Public hearing, review, and recommendation on a proposed Code Text Amendment, known as Park Strips and Trees, of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Chapter 12.16, the Code Text Amendment plans to repeal the existing chapter 12.16 of the American Fork City Code and replace it with the new Chapter 12.16 to provide codification, repeal of conflicting provisions, severability, and an effective date for an updated park strips and trees ordinance.      

 	Description: Providing a new and rewritten Chapter 12.16 of the American Fork City Code to provide regulations regarding park strips and trees. This code will provide information regarding planting trees within park strips and repeal conflicting provisions of the City code. 

Shortly before the public hearing, supporting documentation is posted on the city website at www.americanfork.gov or available by contacting the City Recorder at 801.763.3000.

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS
________________________________________
Notice is hereby given that the American Fork City Planning Commission will hold a Public Hearing on August 19, 2026, at 6:30 PM, in the American Fork City Hall, located at 31 N. Church Street, American Fork, Utah, to receive public comment and consider the following proposed legislative land use actions before making recommendations to the American Fork City Council.

Prior Public Outreach and Project Refinement
Earlier this year, the City initiated a comprehensive planning effort that included a proposed update to the American Fork General Plan, a comprehensive rewrite of the City's Development Code, and a proposed citywide zoning map amendment. The City provided public notice, conducted public outreach, and invited public comment on each of these initiatives.
Following public outreach, review of comments received, additional technical analysis, and continued refinement of the project, the City determined that additional work on the proposed citywide zoning map amendment, and development code update was appropriate. Accordingly, the proposed zoning map amendment and update of the development code have been removed from the current legislative process and will not be considered as part of this public hearing.

This public hearing is limited to consideration of the proposed General Plan Update.
1. General Plan Update

The Planning Commission will consider a proposed update to the American Fork General Plan. The General Plan establishes the City's long-range vision, goals, and policies to guide future growth and development within the community. The update addresses topics including land use, housing, transportation, economic development, public facilities, parks and open space, infrastructure, environmental stewardship, and other elements necessary to plan for the City's future.

Further Information
A layperson's summary of the proposed Development Code Rewrite, together with draft documents and supporting materials, is available at:
https://www.americanfork.gov/generalplan

Copies of the proposed General Plan Update, staff reports, and supporting materials are also available for public review on the City's website and at the American Fork Planning Department during regular business hours.

How to Participate:
Interested persons are invited to attend the public hearing and provide oral testimony or submit written comments to the Planning Department before the hearing.

Following the public hearing, the Planning Commission may recommend approval, approval with modifications, or denial of the proposed legislative actions to the American Fork City Council. The City Council will hold a separate public meeting before taking final legislative action on each proposal.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, individuals needing special accommodations (including auxiliary communicative aids and services) during this hearing should notify the City Recorder at (801) 763-3000 at least three (3) working days prior to the hearing.

For additional information, please contact the American Fork Planning & Zoning Division at (801) 763-3060 or Melissa White at mwhite@americanfork.gov.

Published this 30th day of July 2026.

notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS

Notice is hereby given that the American Fork City Planning Commission will hold a Public Hearing on July 8, 2026, in the City Hall, located at 31 N. Church Street, commencing at 6:30 PM. 
The public and each affected entity is invited to provide information and comment for American Fork City to consider in the process of the proposed items.
-	Notice of public hearings and public meetings on adoption or modification of land use regulation.

o	Public hearing, review, and recommendation on a proposed Code Text Amendment, known as Floodplain Management, of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Section 15.16, the Code Text Amendment plans to amend the code related to Floodplain Management. 

 	Description: The proposed amendment seeks to amend the municipal code to ensure compliance with updated and revised FEMA maps and regulations. 

o	Public hearing on a proposed Code Text Amendment, known as Easements, of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Section 15.01.110, the Code Text Amendment plans to clarify the required conveyance documents for easements.

 	Description: The amendment establishes what document type must be used to convey easements, requiring conveyance on a plat when a plat is required, and a graphical exhibit tied to the Utah County Surveyor's monument system when a plat is not required.


o	Public hearing, review, and recommendation on a proposed Code Text Amendment, known as AF014-Natural Gas Regulator Station, of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Section 17.4.601 PF Public Facilities Zone, the Code Text Amendment proposes Natural Gas Regulator Stations as a Conditional Use within the zone.

 	Description: The Code Text Amendment looks to permit Natural Gas Regulator Stations within the PF Zone as a Conditional Use due to increase growth within American Fork City.


o	Public hearing, review, and recommendation on a proposed Code Text Amendment, known as 'N' Definitions, of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Section 17.12.214, the Code Text Amendment plans to provide a definition to Natural Gas Regulator Stations.

 	Description: As Natural Gas Regulator Stations are not found within the definitions of the City's Code, the City proposes to create a definition to prevent ambiguity about what Natural Gas Regulator Station is.



Shortly before the public hearing, supporting documentation is posted on the city website at www.americanfork.gov or available by contacting the City Recorder at 801.763.3000.

Dated this 24th day of June 2026
